builds.title: Fey’ri canopy scout, Rogue 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 3 (1 class HD, LA +2).
traits: Neutral. Leather armor +2 and Dexterity +4. Touch 14, flat-footed 12. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +1, Reflex +6, Will +1. Improved Initiative adds +4.
Immune to magic sleep. +2 racial bonus on Will saves against enchantment spells and effects.

Change Shape (Su). At will as a standard action, assume a humanoid form. The new form supplies its size and movement modes. Retain the original type, ability scores, Hit Dice, hit points, saves, and spellcasting. Gain +10 on Disguise when using the ability for a disguise.
The natural winged form has a 40-ft. fly speed with poor maneuverability. Core flight requires a light load or less.
Elven Blood makes the fey’ri count as an elf for elf-specific effects and items.
Four Demonic Abilities are darkness 1/day, detect thoughts 1/day, fire resistance 10, and +2 racial on saves against poison. Caster level 1. Trapfinding and Sneak Attack +1d6.
actions: Shortbow +4 ranged for 1d6 piercing, critical ×3, range increment 60 ft. Rapier +0 melee for 1d6 piercing, critical 18–20/×2.
Detect thoughts is Will DC 12. Darkness uses caster level 1. Both are racial spell-like abilities.
Assume a human disguise at Disguise +14. The human form moves 30 ft. on land. Return to natural form before taking off at fly 40 ft. with poor maneuverability.
builds.tactics: Vaelis approaches the checkpoint in a human disguise. Once past the watch, she returns to her natural shape before crossing the broad gap on the wing. She keeps her load light and leaves enough room to turn.

builds.title: Fey’ri courtyard courier, Sorcerer 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 4 (1 class HD, LA +3).
traits: Neutral. Unarmored, Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 10. BAB +0, grapple +0. Fortitude +1, Reflex +3, Will +2. Improved Initiative adds +4. No familiar is present.
Immune to magic sleep. +2 racial bonus on Will saves against enchantment spells and effects.

Change Shape (Su). At will as a standard action, assume a humanoid form. The new form supplies its size and movement modes. Retain the original type, ability scores, Hit Dice, hit points, saves, and spellcasting. Gain +10 on Disguise when using the ability for a disguise.
The natural winged form has a 40-ft. fly speed with poor maneuverability. Core flight requires a light load or less.
Elven Blood makes the fey’ri count as an elf for elf-specific effects and items.
Four Demonic Abilities are dimension door 1/day, charm person 1/day, detect thoughts 1/day, and fire resistance 10. Dimension door is the marked choice, giving LA +3. Caster level 1.
actions: Light crossbow +3 ranged for 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, range increment 80 ft.

Dimension door reaches 440 ft. at caster level 1. Its passenger allowance starts at caster level 3. After using it, Nyrel can take no further actions until the next turn. Charm person is Will DC 14 and detect thoughts is Will DC 15.

Sorcerer spells known, CL 1. Detect magic, mage hand, message, and prestidigitation share five cantrip slots. Mage armor and grease share four 1st-level slots. Mage armor raises AC to 17 for 1 hour, touch 13, flat-footed 14. Grease is Reflex DC 14 and lasts 1 round.
builds.tactics: Nyrel scouts the courtyard in a humanoid guise, then uses dimension door to carry the message across the closed gate after the party clears the far side.

concepts.name: Vaelis Ashthread
concepts.motive: Find a route across the gap before the checkpoint changes shift.
concepts.hook: Vaelis waits on the far side of the checkpoint in a human disguise.

concepts.name: Nyrel Duskmantle
concepts.motive: Get the message to the far side of the gate before it seals.
concepts.hook: Nyrel can cross the gate once the party confirms a clear landing.
